Who We Are

Born from the
Palmyra Palm

Enn Panai is a Tamil Nadu-based startup pioneering the world's first commercially viable palmyra palm fibre for luxury apparel. Founded by women from Viruppatchi village, Dindigul, we transform agro-waste from the Palmyra fruit into premium, biodegradable textile fibre — creating dignified livelihoods while regenerating the very trees that sustain us.

100 Yr Tree Lifespan
100% Women Workforce
0 Synthetic Inputs
The Innovation

From fruit to fabric

Palmyra fruits — previously discarded as agro-waste — are hand-processed by our all-women team through an 8-step proprietary process. The resulting fibre blends with long-staple cotton (90:10) to produce a yarn of exceptional softness, natural lustre, and full biodegradability.

Product Portfolio

Two fibre streams

👗
Fine Fibre — Apparel Grade
Premium shirts, kurtas, sarees & luxury fashion. Silky handle, natural luminosity, fully biodegradable.
🏠
Coarse Fibre — Home & Furnishing
Upholstery, rugs, table runners & décor articles. 30–40% premium over synthetic alternatives in EU markets.
🌱
Sapling Nursery Programme
Post-extraction seeds cultivated into saplings — rejuvenating palmyra groves and securing perpetual supply.

Sustainability

Palmyra trees sequester carbon over their 100-year lifespan — making every metre of Enn Panai fabric net carbon-negative. Our sapling nursery ensures the grove regenerates perpetually.
